evidence.label: Ethereum proof of stake
evidence.claim: Ethereum uses proof of stake; validators re-execute transactions, validate blocks, and attest to their view of the chain.

evidence.label: Ethereum proof-of-stake keys
evidence.claim: Ethereum validator signing keys use the BLS signature scheme and are distinct from execution-account keys.

evidence.label: Ethereum Gasper
evidence.claim: Gasper combines Casper-FFG finality with the LMD-GHOST fork-choice algorithm.

evidence.label: Ethereum quantum resistance roadmap
evidence.claim: Consensus-signature migration is a distinct post-quantum workstream and is not represented here as deployed.
